decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Reason: Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004). 
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

 EXISTING PROPOSED FRONT ELEVATION DATED 06.05.2026 submitted  23/02/2026

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Windows: aluminium frame powder coated RAL 7021
Doors: frameless glazed

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.
Condition : 4 - No external security shutters shall be installed to the hereby approved shopfront.

 To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC5 and DC8 of the Local Plan 2018. 
Condition : 5 - Unless otherwise indicated on the approved drawings, the shopfront glass shall remain permanently clear and unobscured. The glazing of the shopfront hereby approved shall not be mirrored, painted or otherwise obscured.

In order to safeguard the appearance of the shopfront, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC5 and DC8 of the Local Plan 2018. 
Condition : 6 - The proposed shopfront doors hereby approved shall open inwards.

To prevent obstruction of the public highway in accordance with the Highways Act 1980, and Policy T3 of the Local Plan 2018
Condition : 7 - Free Text condition
